mapper.insert: insert into abr_growth_signal (signal_type, agent_code, account_code, target_type, target_id, task_id, detail, source, create_by, create_time) values (#{signalType}, #{agentCode}, #{accountCode}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{taskId}, cast(coalesce(#{detail}, '{}') as jsonb), coalesce(#{source}, 'system'), coalesce(#{createBy}, ''), now())
mapper.select: select account_code as "accountCode", count(*) as "count" from abr_growth_signal where signal_type = #{signalType} and create_time >= #{since} and account_code is not null and account_code <> '' group by account_code
